environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer). PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with standard connection pooling via PgBouncer in transaction mode. The database role used by the application (`app_service`) is a superuser role inherited from initial provisioning. RLS policies exist on tables but are not enforced for the app_service role since ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY was never applied, and the role has BYPASSRLS privilege. Session store uses default MemoryStore. No session regeneration on authentication.
